Thus, I am proud to present DOOMFORMER. Here are a list of things DOOMFORMER can do : It can classify MNIST digits, even if you write these digits on the map! The marine's mind can be controlled by DOOM, playing on a map generated by DOOMFORMER. Truly, the possibilities are endless, and even larger-scale training of DOOMFORMER could be done on a measly T4. In software, AI can run and test code inside your computer in a matter of seconds. But as firmware engineers, we didn’t have that luxury. An AI agent can write firmware in seconds, but in order to test it, we had to flash a physical board, then manually run tests using expensive and clunky tools with software made over a decade ago. - A CI/CD pipeline for your hardware projects that validates your firmware against a simulated version of the microcontroller on every commit. For safety critical systems like avionics and automotives, a robust simulation system is incredibly important, because every change in the firmware puts a human life at stake, especially for machines that cost hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars. items.title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
items.titleZh: LRMoE：需求侧负载重新校准，以在内存受限节点上进行高效 MoE 训练
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37720v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

items.title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
items.titleZh: 用于模型校准的摊销局部后验推理及其在海洋湍流闭合中的应用
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37731v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$\epsilon$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

摘要：模型差异可能会阻止单个校准参数在上下文域中再现物理响应。此外，观测和背景的不确定性会影响校准，必须予以考虑和量化。我们通过根据观察可能性与目标上下文的接近程度来加权，构建了一系列局部后验。高斯定位权重通过协方差膨胀合并上下文不确定性，并在域边界处进行反射，并对不均匀的上下文采样进行可选的校正。条件归一化流通过摊销变分推理来近似后验家族。在规定的上下文测量下积分局部后验给出边缘化参数分布。在 Branin-Hoo 模型的孪生实验中，我们比较了均匀和倾斜上下文分布下的全局和局部推理。本地化减少了报告的相对于全局后验的总体预测误差。以大气表面强迫为背景的单柱海洋模型中 k-$\epsilon$ 湍流闭合的应用表明，相对于确定性和全局后验校准，局部后验校准减少了温度和纬向速度误差。这两个双胞胎实验都是为了接受局部补偿而构建的。

items.title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
items.titleZh: ThinkJev：一个想法，每个预算，用于校准类型决策
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37732v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.

arXiv:2610.37732v1 公告类型：新
摘要：语言模型的许多使用都以类型化决策结束：在一组封闭的选项中进行选择，其概率代码可以起作用。从一次前向传递中读取这些概率的速度很快，但对于需要几个步骤的决策（例如算术、计数和日期比较）来说通常是错误的。让模型首先思考可以修复大部分错误，但每个决策的成本是几秒而不是几毫秒。为了只在有帮助的地方进行思考，ThinkJev 从一个开放的混合思维模型构建了一个快速和慢速的系统，可以直接或在思考后回答。系统1在直接回答时读取模型对于选项字母的概率；在模型思考相同的缓存提示后，系统 2 会读取相同的字母，因此升级不会重复任何工作，并且两个系统都会给出相同选项的概率。因为可以在任意数量的思想标记之后读取这些字母，所以一个抽样思想也可以在每个思想预算下给出答案。在没有训练的情况下，ThinkJev 仅在对标记的开发数据进行统计测试保证其接受的答案保持在目标错误率以下的情况下才让系统 1 单独回答。在 5% 的目标下，Qwen3.5-27B 以这种方式回答了 8359 个测试决策中的 24.5%，实现误差为 3.9%（Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B：6.5% 和 0.0%）。对于其余的，一旦答案有把握就停止每个想法，准确率达到 81.6%，而始终思考的准确率达到 82.7%，思维标记为 72%。仅根据系统 1 的信心来选择何时进行思考节省的成本较少，因为系统 1 最不确定的决策通常不是思考修复的决策。在类型决策服务的独立基准 JevBench 的公开项目上，Qwen3.5-27B 的思考率为 29.4%，并且在准确性上与列出的两个思考 API 没有区别（探索性）。代码和数据生成器可在 https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev 获取。

items.title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
items.titleZh: OpenFrontiers：开放研究问题的集合和科学重新发现的基准
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37739v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37739v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）在解决研究级问题方面显示出越来越大的前景，但仍然缺乏此类问题的全面集合，并且在研究级问题上评估它们仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍 OpenFrontiers，这是一个跨学科资源，它将开放研究问题的结构化语料库与最近解决的数学问题的回顾性基准相结合。该语料库记录了 12,151 个问题的问题陈述、背景、进度和其他信息。该基准包含 200 个问题，其中 110 个将于 2026 年解决，90 个仍悬而未决，每个问题都有一个由自动探针和两次独立审查检查的 Lean~4 声明； HQ-50 子集根据质量分数等进一步过滤。我们的评估协议在闭卷、冻结检索和实时网络条件下，在隔离沙箱中使用两个独立检查器对形式证明进行评分。在标准化预算下评估 HQ-50 子集上的 7 个 LLM 代理，我们发现闭卷重新发现的情况很少见，最多 40 个已解决问题中的 7 个，而实时网络的成功主要反映了对已发布解决方案的检索。通过将广泛的研究问题语料库与带有记录解决方案的正式分级评估子集联系起来，OpenFrontiers 为衡量研究水平的重新发现和研究解决当前开放科学问题的进展奠定了基础。数据集和基准可以在 https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/​​openfrontiers 中找到。

items.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
items.titleZh: WebAnything：从狂野的网络到可扩展的代理环境
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37786v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
 We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
 We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37786v1 公告类型：新
摘要：Web 代理需要多样化、可执行且可重置的网站环境来进行可重复的培训和评估。人工辅助镜子需要针对每个站点进行工程设计，而生成式构建可能与指定的真实网站有所不同。捕获和重放保留了观察结果，交互范围受到捕获的内容和重放功能的限制。
 我们推出了 WebAnything，这是一个完全自动化的框架，它可以从真实的 URL 重建基于源代码的、可重用的 Web 环境，无需在初始设置和授权后针对每个站点进行手动实施或修复。 Explorer-Builder 收集浏览器可观察的结构、资源和交互结果；独立验证者检查冻结的候选者并指导本地修复或有针对性的源重新捕获。
 我们构建了 14 个应用程序域和 53 个类别的 244 个网站工件，支持 12,984 个执行和接受的任务。与人工辅助的 WebHarbor 相比，WebAnything 在三个保真度指标上取得了更高的总分，在盲审中取得了 12 胜、2 平、无失分的成绩。对 5,856 个交互轨迹进行微调 Qwen3.5-9B 将 REAL 成功率提高了 9.9 个百分点，Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg 和 Task Avg 提高了 6.25 和 6.32 个百分点，WebArena-Verified 总体成功率在固定控制下提高了 13.33 个百分点。代码：https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

items.title: What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
items.titleZh: 本体抓住什么？策划、LLM 生成和数据衍生的本体作为知识图谱上 LLM 代理的检查器
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37809v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37809v1 公告类型：新
摘要：通过网络知识图回答问题的 LLM 代理越来越多地包含在从图本体派生的检查中，假设形式模式可以做出可靠的判断。然而，检查器也可能是错误的：它可能会错过错误，并且它可以标记正确的答案并推动代理“修复”它们。作为这样的法官，精心策划的本体是否值得付出代价，以及它如何与法学硕士编写的本体或从数据中挖掘的模式进行比较，都是未知的。我们把检查器本身作为研究对象。在精心策划的、LLM 生成的和数据派生的本体中，用作提示上下文、检查器或两者兼而有之，以及在公共图和近 10^{9}$ 三倍的私有图上的开放权重和专有代理，我们解释了本体派生检查捕获的内容以及它们错误标记的内容。我们展示了每个源交易如何捕获错误以防止误报，发布时使用的策划模式如何与自己的数据相矛盾，结构检查遗漏了哪些错误，以及合并源或向代理提供检查器的特定反馈是否会带来回报。在 UniProt 上，与从数据派生的本体或法学硕士从具有屏蔽标识符的数据摘要派生的本体相比，精心策划的本体标记了更正确的答案。在真实代理的答案中，其标志仅比随机标志稍微精确一些。

items.title: Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
items.titleZh: 测量代理智能合约综合中意图丢失的位置
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37830v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.
 We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about half the difference between pipelines.
 We then propose an elicitation-first architecture. Before writing code, the agent asks the client a short checklist of questions, checks the contract against an independently written executable answer key, and returns disagreements to the client instead of silently rewriting code. Asking first matters far more than reviewing or patching afterwards, across three AI models, while automated security fixes often break requested behavior. A few well-chosen questions recover much of what a short description omits, and their value can be estimated without the original contract. To our knowledge, this is the first study in smart contract synthesis to gather missing requirements before generation and check the result against an independently written executable model. The lessons extend to any setting where AI agents turn requests into programs. We release our tools, 600 tasks and all results.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37830v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能代理现在可以根据简单的英语描述编写软件，但运行的代码与执行要求的代码不同。这一差距对于智能合约来说最为重要，智能合约是 Web3 应用程序背后的程序，在区块链上转移资金，一旦部署就无法修复。我们询问如何检查人工智能编写的合约是否按其应有的方式运行，以及所请求的行为在哪里丢失。
 我们设计的评估基于执行而不是意见。我们在人工智能编写的合同上重播相同的交易，并且在原始合同上它应该重现并衡量他们同意的频率。我们测试每个评分工具的植入错误，与没有描述的答案进行比较，并审核我们自己的评分员，直到已知的错误答案无法通过。常见的方法，例如人工智能法官和标准分析工具，会错过明显的错误，而评分选择也很重要。仅检查每个系统包含的功能隐藏了管道之间大约一半的差异。
 然后，我们提出了一种启发优先的架构。在编写代码之前，代理会询问客户一个简短的问题清单，根据独立编写的可执行答案检查合同，并将分歧返回给客户，而不是默默地重写代码。在三种人工智能模型中，首先询问比事后检查或修补更重要，而自动安全修复通常会破坏所请求的行为。一些精心挑选的问题可以弥补简短描述所遗漏的大部分内容，并且无需原始合同即可估算其价值。据我们所知，这是智能合约综合领域的第一项研究，旨在在生成之前收集缺失的需求，并根据独立编写的可执行模型检查结果。这些经验教训适用于人工智能代理将请求转化为程序的任何环境。我们发布了我们的工具、600 项任务和所有结果。

items.title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
items.titleZh: 通过合作伙伴与外部人的积极倾听来检测人工智能代理之间的秘密勾结
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37849v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37849v1 公告类型：新
摘要：共享秘密约定的人工智能代理可以通过看起来无辜的消息进行协调，因此只读取消息的监视器可能会错过它们。我们提出了一种行为测试：使用代码的合作伙伴会对消息的确切措辞做出反应，而坐在其座位上的未参与的代理则不会。合作伙伴——局外人积极倾听（PoPLi）是两个代理之间的差异，即当消息被改写并保留其含义时，他们的行为发生了多少变化，并且是在事后通过重播记录的提示来计算的。在具有五种条件（无共谋、中立消息联合奖励、公开声明意图、隐蔽首字母代码和具有声明意图的代码）的模拟市场中，只要存在代码，PoPLi 就在 0.48 到 0.59 之间（95% 的区间均高于 0.29），在没有代码的情况下，PoPLi 介于 -0.10 到 -0.01 之间。仅消息监控器并未区分条件：一名阅读发言者消息的人在所有 50 个市场中回答“否”，而一名阅读每个卖家消息的人则标记了 10 个市场中的 9 个市场没有串通。 PoPLi 检测的是私人渠道的使用，而不是共谋本身，并且它无法仅通过激励或带有意义的代码来检测共谋。

items.title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding
items.titleZh: 评估和改进人工智能代理以理解测序协议
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37851v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural rules and cross-protocol examples showed non-monotonic validation performance and no mean held-out molecular-workflow improvement in the tested trajectory. These findings highlight the need for more controlled and verifiable approaches to scientific reasoning about molecular processes in complex experimental protocols.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37851v1 公告类型：新
摘要：现有的科学代理基准很少评估代理是否可以重建测序协议指定的精确分子结构和生成工作流程，而这对于分析定制测序测定至关重要。我们推出了 LibStructBench，这是一个基于文档的基准，用于重建测序文库结构和分子工作流程。我们的实验表明，前沿代理通常会产生大致正确的重建，但在精确重建时仍然不可靠，特别是在分子状态表示和工作流程连接方面。切换底层语言模型比切换代理工具产生更大的平均性能差异，仅在分子状态重建方面存在统计显着差异。额外的知识改善了小型试验中寡核苷酸家族的恢复，但没有提高平均分子工作流程分数。程序规则和跨协议示例的自主积累显示出非单调验证性能，并且在测试轨迹中没有平均保留的分子工作流程改进。这些发现强调需要更多受控和可验证的方法来对复杂实验方案中的分子过程进行科学推理。

items.title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
items.titleZh: Seq@K：评估顺序反馈下的语言模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37859v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37859v1 公告类型：新
摘要：语言模型代理与现有智能系统的根本区别在于它们从上下文中的自然语言学习的能力。此功能使代理能够根据反馈迭代地完善其答案，这是现代代理工作流程中普遍的操作模式。然而，社区主要通过 Pass@1 或 Pass@K 等指标对模型进行排名，这些指标无法捕获他们如何利用先前尝试的反馈。我们引入了 Seq@K，这是一种自然评估协议，用于衡量模型是否可以在 K 个连续尝试内解决问题，并在每次失败后提供反馈。与检查长期规划的多轮代理基准不同，Seq@K 从反馈中分离并形式化了细化的核心能力。我们在一组 7 个基准和 16 个前沿模型上评估 Seq@K，并表明 Seq@K 揭示了一种本质上不同的模型选择景观：在 Seq@K 下，（1）模型排名通常不同，（2）帕累托前沿允许更有效的配置，（3）选择最佳模型配置的收益相对于 Pass@K 可能会扩大或缩小。我们进一步表明，分析 Seq@K 下的模型轨迹有助于表征迭代细化行为，例如模型解决反馈中提出的问题的速度，或者它们对自己答案的严格程度。最后，我们研究反馈的性质如何影响模型的迭代细化，表明从业者必须仔细设计迭代代理系统的反馈循环并对其进行基准测试。总之，这些结果确立了 Seq@K 如何为通常在此类反馈循环中运行的智能系统提供更可靠的度量，以及在评估这些系统的模型时考虑 Seq@K 的必要性。

items.title: What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine
items.titleZh: 什么构成了食物的相似性？印度美食的视觉表征和检索
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37867v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37867v1 公告类型：新
摘要：食物相似性是检索、推荐、替代和其他食物计算任务的基础，但食物表示通常是通过身份保留来评估的。我们询问超越身份的食物相似性会发生什么：不同的视觉表征如何将食物组织成相关的邻域，这些邻域揭示或掩盖了哪些烹饪关系，以及这些结构在表征中的一致性如何。印度美食提供了一个具有挑战性的环境，其中视觉上相似的食物可能具有不同的烹饪特性，而烹饪家族中的食物在外观上可能有很大差异。使用扩展的 Khana 数据集和七个预训练的视觉表示，涵盖卷积、基于变压器、自监督和图像文本对齐模型，我们评估图像到图像检索和图像到菜肴邻域，检查烹饪家庭结构、对比案例和交叉表示一致性。我们还聚合图像表示，以比较模型之间菜肴级别的视觉相似性以及相同菜肴的食谱衍生相似性。图像层面的邻域在不同的表征中存在很大差异，包括跨烹饪家庭边界的相似性。在菜肴层面，尽管存在局部差异，但聚合揭示了共同的视觉结构，但这种结构与食谱衍生的相似性的对应性不太强。这些发现表明，仅识别性能无法表征关系结构：食物相似性取决于表示、模态和抽象级别，而不是食物集合的固定属性。因此，理解这些结构是将多种食品信息模式结合成连贯的相似性概念的先决条件。

items.title: Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment
items.titleZh: 验证学习理论：人工智能辅助判断中的检查和保留过程模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37875v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments; they do not constitute empirical validation. Comparisons with depth-of-processing and feedback-encoding accounts identify where predictions diverge and where the accounts remain observationally equivalent. The framework specifies experiments that can test the proposed mechanism and separates retention of practised rules from the broader problem of recognising which rule applies to a new claim.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37875v1 公告类型：新
摘要：准确的人工智能辅助可以提高即时判断，同时减少练习独立表演所需操作的机会。验证学习理论（VLT）将这种索赔评估实践的可能性正式化，然后是正确的、独立的、针对特定规则的反馈。该模型将感知的助理可靠性与证据检查联系起来，并将这些检查的历史与保留的规则使用联系起来。其严格的形式假设任务要求和感知的可靠性仅通过检查影响学习，并且每次真正的检查都有相同的学习效果。因此，它预测，即使没有观察到辅助错误，感知到的易错性也可以改善延迟的独立判断，并且当已经需要并执行检查时，这种优势就会消失。通过检查历史记录得出的特定规则的收益和预测提供了进一步的测试。模拟检查这些承诺的后果和参数依赖性；它们不构成经验验证。与深度处理和反馈编码帐户的比较可以确定预测的分歧之处以及帐户在观察上保持相同的地方。该框架指定了可以测试所提出的机制的实验，并将实践规则的保留与识别哪个规则适用于新权利要求的更广泛的问题分开。

items.title: The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning
items.titleZh: 多元攻击性建模中的社会人口统计学剖析：何时何地有帮助，以及推理的作用
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37896v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but systematic demographic signals. Second, using a reasoning and prediction format that explicitly decomposes individual judgment into an overall baseline and a demographic-specific deviation, we show that the gains arise from both components: demographic information improves baseline estimation and enables meaningful demographic-specific shifts, and interventions show that better component estimates improve final predictions. Finally, comparing direct demographic conditioning with explicit reasoning about how the text interacts with annotator demographics, we find that reasoning yields more accurate baseline and shift estimates as well as final predictions, whereas conditioning alone rarely produces informative shifts. These results suggest that the mixed evidence in prior work may partly stem from individual-level evaluation, and that the value of socio-demographic information depends on both how it is evaluated and how models are guided to use it.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37896v1 公告类型：新
摘要：诸如冒犯性之类的主观判断通常因人而异，这激发了采用结合注释者的社会人口统计信息的多元建模方法来捕获这种差异。然而，先前关于社会人口统计信息对多元建模的好处的研究结果好坏参半，需要对其有效性及其改进预测的机制进行系统分析。在这项工作中，我们研究了$\textbf{何时}$和$\textbf{其中}$社会人口统计有利于多元攻击性建模，以及$\textbf{显式推理的作用}$在利用这些信息中的作用。在具有提示和训练有素的法学硕士的三个多注释器数据集中，我们首先表明人口统计增益很小且与个人预测不一致，但在群体和人口水平上变得更加清晰，因为聚合减弱了掩盖小但系统的人口统计信号的特殊变化。其次，使用将个人判断明确分解为总体基线和人口特定偏差的推理和预测格式，我们表明收益来自两个组成部分：人口统计信息改善了基线估计并实现了有意义的人口特定转变，而干预措施表明更好的组成部分估计可以改善最终预测。最后，将直接人口统计调节与关于文本如何与注释者人口统计交互的显式推理进行比较，我们发现推理产生更准确的基线和变化估计以及最终预测，而单独的调节很少产生信息变化。这些结果表明，先前工作中的混合证据可能部分源于个人层面的评估，社会人口统计信息的价值取决于如何评估它以及如何指导模型使用它。

items.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
items.titleZh: FilingLoop：评估和发展法学硕士代理人以进行公司披露审查和修订
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37905v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.

arXiv:2610.37905v1 公告类型：新
摘要： SEC EDGAR 等公开披露存储库通过网络访问公司文件来支持知情投资。支持语言模型代理的审查需要发现相关文档中未说明的缺陷，获取缺失的公司事实，并验证所请求的修订满足有证据支持的要求。现有的金融问答评估为这些交互能力提供了有限的证据。我们引入 \textbf{FilingLoop}，一个用于公司披露审查和修订的交互式基准和自我进化代理框架。 FilingLoop 以美国证券交易委员会的历史信件为基础，在不同的信息限制下重建了来自 96 家公司的 380 项主要 IPO 审查任务。独立于代理机构的评估员根据 6,099 项合格要求对最终申请和答复进行评分，并审核不受支持的索赔和有害的修订。我们的框架将每个案例中的迭代审查和修订与跨案例的程序学习结合起来，将需求级别的评估反馈转换为特定于角色的指导，而无需更新模型权重。更新仅影响后续案例，允许评估程序适应性而无需重试评分任务。在评估的流上，演进将需求满足率从 24.28% 提高到 27.96%，完整评论分辨率从 16.90% 提高到 20.75%，与固定策略变体相比，总成本增加了 5.8%。 FilingLoop 将代理发现的问题与其获得的公司事实和提交的修订联系起来，为后续审核任务中使用的程序提供需求级反馈。

items.title: Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
items.titleZh: 超越低通动力学：具有共振神经元的频率选择性尖峰储层
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37906v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. The result is more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy than LIF-based reservoirs, achieved without sacrificing the energy efficiency of spiking computation, with up to 19x lower energy consumption than an equivalent non-spiking oscillatory reservoir. Evaluated on ten benchmarks spanning time series, sequential images, audio spike trains, and neuromorphic vision, HRF-Res achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among spiking reservoir methods. These results demonstrate that introducing frequency-selective dynamics into spiking reservoirs improves representational quality and classification performance while preserving their inherent energy efficiency.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37906v1 公告类型：新
摘要：尖峰存储库计算将固定循环存储库的训练效率与事件驱动推理的能量效率结合起来，其中计算由稀疏尖峰触发，而不是在每个时间步密集执行。然而，现有的尖峰储存器几乎完全依赖于泄漏积分激发（LIF）神经元，其低通动态限制了它们区分以不同时间频率编码的信息的能力。我们介绍了 HRF-Res，这是一种液态机，其中 LIF 神经元被异质的谐波共振与激发 (HRF) 神经元群体所取代。这些神经元表现出内在的振荡动力学，并选择性地响应输入频率，使储存器能够捕获特定频率的时间模式。与基于 LIF 的储存器相比，其结果是更具辨别力的表示和更高的分类精度，并且在不牺牲尖峰计算的能源效率的情况下实现，与同等的非尖峰振荡储存器相比，能耗降低了 19 倍。 HRF-Res 对涵盖时间序列、序列图像、音频尖峰序列和神经形态视觉的 10 个基准进行了评估，在尖峰储层方法中实现了最先进的准确性。这些结果表明，将频率选择性动力学引入尖峰储层可以提高表征质量和分类性能，同时保持其固有的能量效率。
items.author: Aurora Micheli, Claudio Gallicchio, Nergis Tomen

items.title: Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates
items.titleZh: 用于嘈杂深度学习的矩引导优化器：MGO-SC 作为 Adam 式更新的简单一致性门
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37712v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.37712v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自适应优化器广泛应用于深度学习中，但其行为在严重随机性和标签噪声下可能会降低，其中梯度的符号和大小可能不稳定。我们研究了 MGO-SC（具有符号一致性的矩引导优化器），这是 Adam 式方法的轻量级修改，它从符号指数移动平均值（EMA）的大小导出坐标一致性门：梯度符号稳定的坐标是可信的，而符号波动的坐标是向下加权的。我们证明了这个门的朴素形式只能缩小更新，失去有效步长，并且当学习率与基线匹配时表现不佳。因此，我们引入了一种均值保留变体，可以在不改变每个张量净步幅值的情况下跨坐标重新分配信任。在使用 ResNet-18 的 CIFAR-10 上，在匹配的学习率和解耦权重衰减下，均值保留 MGO-SC 在干净、对称和不对称标签噪声方面持续优于其 AdamW 基线（例如，40% 对称噪声时 +1.4 个点；配对引导 95% CI 排除零；Wilcoxon p<0.01），同时不添加二阶信息或每个样本过滤。我们报告匹配种子效应大小、非参数引导置信区间和配对显着性检验，并发布代码和原始日志。
items.author: Alicem Koyun

items.title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
items.titleZh: 体重更新能带来什么：跨训练阶段的利用
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37719v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, T\"ulu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,\rho_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

arXiv:2610.37719v1 公告类型：新
摘要：训练后将语言模型的权重移动大约千分之一，并急剧改变其行为；预训练使它们移动了三分之一并获得了缓慢的漂移。我们引入了杠杆，这是对重量变化单位购买的精确度量：更新的费舍尔二次形式，通过每个方向一次前向模式传递来计算，除以同一检查点相同大小的随机方向的相同形式。利用 Olmo-3、T\"ulu-3、Zephyr 和 OLMo-2 检查点发布的命令超过四个数量级：预训练窗口位于散文的随机级别，SFT 是其之上的五倍，RL-Zero 和 RLVR 为 400-1,500，DPO 为 400-23,000。使用此工具，我们发现预训练会累积成噪声：30k 到 30k 的窗口正如 SGD 的噪声二次模型所预测的那样，1M 个步骤对散文的影响并不比其大小的随机方向更大：在没有 fp32 主副本的情况下训练 bf16 参数会冻结 36-99% 的坐标，将杠杆率降低多达七倍，并在更新幅度和费舍尔对角线之间创建对齐，而这是 fp32 训练无法显示的。预测随机下降和重新缩放 (DARE) 保持速率 $p$ 为 $(1-p)/(p\,\rho_{\mathrm{sign}})$ 的相对损坏，只要 DARE 成功，两个控制装置使这些读数可靠：每个带有 fp32 主权重的受控 SFT 和 DPO 轨迹在移动时会失去杠杆作用，并且从其锚点重新运行已发布的 DPO 阶段，其中包含已发布的配方。释放的位移的 1% 和其杠杆的 4%，其中普通配方的读数低五到六倍；将一个组件排除在外，可将其水平归一化到 128 的批量大小。

items.title: Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations
items.titleZh: 偏微分方程神经发现中的阈值兼容性和支持选择诊断
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37726v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

arXiv:2610.37726v1 公告类型：新
摘要：准确的回归不需要在选择支持后产生正确的方程。对于神经偏微分方程发现中的中值/样本标准差阈值，我们推导出精确的两信号保留边界和完整向量扰动界限。尽管系数恢复到数值精度，但精确的平流扩散库会失去扩散。对 40 个保存的稀疏状态的真实支撑改装可减少扩散误差，而无需恢复所有导数精度。固定顺序阈值脊比较器恢复了六十个理想控制中的精确支持，但在每个学习状态中选择了额外的项。所有正确支持候选者均被条件验证拒绝；事后能源共享在所有六十个州都保持了较高的最低损失。在对四个未使用的分析轨迹进行的所有 240 次物理残差比较中，提供的支持估计优于未更改的选定方程。系数、观察点和权重固定后，学习库和目标的精确替换会反转其在 59/60 状态下的学习行排序。在每个测试的预算中，对这两种损失进行加权也不符合指定的伯格扩散效益标准。这些有限诊断可区分阈值不兼容、改装损坏和评分拒绝；它们既不建立自动校正，也不建立一般恢复或预测稳定性。

items.title: Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning
items.titleZh: 谓词神经元：基于梯度的学习中谓词关系的可微量化
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37727v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

arXiv:2610.37727v1 公告类型：新
摘要：在机器学习中，符号推理方法通常依赖于静态架构，这阻碍了深度神经网络和基于梯度的优化的集成。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Native Predicate Neuron，这是一种可微分的逻辑推理神经模块，它通过一阶逻辑量化来丰富标准架构的符号推理功能。所提出的神经元通过学习使用单个可训练参数在操作之间交替来对关系逻辑进行建模。它具有定制的梯度机制和双重性质公式：在训练期间执行硬逻辑运算，同时保持反向传播的可微性。通过量化其输入和选择状态，谓词神经元近似连续和非连续函数，有效解决标准深度学习架构难以解决的不连续性。我们在 MNIST 和 Wikitext 等基准上评估全连接、卷积、循环和 Transformer 架构的谓词神经元。结果表明，合并谓词神经元总体上可以加速收敛、提高准确性并降低损失，尤其是在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务中得到显着改进。总体而言，谓词神经元原生集成到标准神经网络中以实现模糊逻辑运算，并且可在 Keras 和 PyTorch 中使用。

items.title: Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs
items.titleZh: 地下水位异常预测的选择性迁移学习：准确性与风险权衡
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37733v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

摘要：这项工作研究了荷兰多井地下水异常预测的上下文感知选择性迁移学习。源域预训练可以提高平均精度，但并不完全可靠：它会降低大部分异质井的性能。情境感知选择性学习（CASL）使用经过校准训练的、冻结的非转移和固定转移父母的约束情境混合。全局凸混合使用相同的亲本，每颗种子都有一个校准拟合的重量。纠正后的任务需要九个连续观察的每月输入和一个精确的三个日历月目标，无需插值。评估涵盖 5 个预定义种子下的 457 个孔和 13,718 个测试窗口，仅使用 Always-TL 验证 RMSE 冻结四细胞 maxsim0.60 源池。固定转移损害井数为18.38-51.86%。 CASL的RMSE比No TL低0.424-1.084%，部分抢救97.53-99.50%，完全抢救23.46-43.78%的固定病害井。部分救援在结构上可以由凸混合产生，并且不会建立上下文优势。 Global Convex Blend 在四个种子中保护了更多的孔，而 CASL 在四个种子中的汇总 RMSE 略低。两者都不占主导地位：结果支持固定分割的准确性风险权衡，而不是滚动部署有效性。

items.title: Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation
items.titleZh: 贝叶斯优化中先验数据拟合网络的各向异性信任区域扭曲
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37737v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Mat\'ern-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

arXiv:2610.37737v1 公告类型：新
摘要：先验数据拟合网络（PFN）用单个前向传递取代了贝叶斯优化中高斯过程（GP）代理的超参数重新拟合，代价是在元训练时固定的先验。我们凭经验证明，随着目标函数的长度规模超出 PFN 元训练先验的模式，PFN 的预测对数似然性越来越落后于改装后的 GP，并且这种缺陷会延续到优化性能。为了在不重新训练网络的情况下纠正不匹配，我们引入了各向异性信任区域（ATR）扭曲。每个维度的长度尺度是通过内核目标对齐来估计的，输入空间的仿射重新缩放将目标映射到 PFN 期望的长度尺度上，锚点周围的信任区域决定保留哪些观测值，从而使 PFN 的 $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ 推理成本保持不变。在从 Mat\'ern-3/2 内核提取的函数上，ATR 扭曲提高了 PFN 在长度尺度范围的两个极端处的优化性能。我们的实现可在 https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs 上公开获取。
items.author: Samuel Younger, Tinkle Chugh, George De Ath

items.title: Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models
items.titleZh: 辐条，而不是环：重新审视语言模型中的工作日流形
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37796v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

arXiv:2610.37796v1 公告类型：新
摘要：最近的工作假设大型语言模型可以将某些概念表示为多维流形而不是单一方向。使用这些流形来解释或引导表示通常假设沿着它们移动对应于所表示概念的连续变化。在这项工作中，我们在原型工作日流形上测试了这种连续流形假设。尽管其圆形几何形状引人注目，但我们发现工作日表示的行为更像是排列在一个圆圈中的七个离散状态，而不是一个连续的环。首先，我们表明局部敏感性有七个与工作日一致的最小值，在流形控制下的表示和行为之间产生阶梯状映射。其次，我们测试是否有任何概念沿着七个离散状态之外的流形表示，并且发现一天中的时间、不确定性和自然文本都没有填充中间空间。总之，这些结果挑战了工作日流形的连续解释，并激发了测试沿着其他表示流形的运动是否对应于模型表示和行为的有意义的变化。
items.author: Diksha Gupta, Rieke Fruengel, Stefan Heimersheim

items.title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
items.titleZh: 用于医学成像的负责任的量子机器学习：跨敏感子组的公平审计
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37819v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

arXiv:2610.37819v1 公告类型：新
摘要：量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类方面的探索越来越多，但其在子组感知公平标准下的行为仍未得到充分研究。假设 QML 本质上并不公平，我们对医学成像的经典分类器和量子分类器进行了实证公平性审核。评估两种情况：DDI 上的皮肤病灶（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick 皮肤类型）和 CheXpert 衍生数据上的胸部 X 光检查（敏感属性：年龄组）。使用 ResNet-18 嵌入，我们在基线和三种缓解设置下训练 SVM、MLP、QSVM 和 QCNN：可微分均衡赔率 (EO) 正则化、梯度反转学习 (GRL) 以及两者的组合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）用作外部参考。量子分类器可以实现有竞争力的总体性能，同时仍然表现出子组差异。由于较小的子组 AUC 差距可能源于降低最好的组而不是改善最差的组，因此每个缓解措施也会根据相对于其基线的预先指定的非劣效性裕度进行测试。在此标准下，几种差异最小的配置，特别是 DDI 上带有 GRL 的 QCNN，由于全局辨别能力的丧失，在临床上是不可接受的。在 DDI 上，带有 GRL+EO 的 QSVM 表现最好，在性能/公平性权衡方面接近 PanDerm；在 CheXpert 上，带有 GRL 的 QCNN 实现了最高的总体性能，但差距加大，而 EVA-X 仍然更强。公平效应取决于模型和数据集，因此 QML 需要经验子组感知评估。所有量子模型都在经典模拟中运行；我们声称没有量子优势。
items.author: Giovanni dos Santos Franco, Felipe Mahlow, Ellison Fernando Cardoso, Jos\'e Adenaldo Santos Bittencourt, Felipe Fanchini

items.title: Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network
items.titleZh: 没有时钟的学习：分区不变神经网络
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37823v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

arXiv:2610.37823v1 公告类型：新
摘要：事件摄像机、尖峰耳蜗和类似的传感器会发出异步事件，但大多数学习系统首先将它们装入帧或数据包中，因此输出取决于流的切片方式。状态在每个事件中精确更新并在事件之间以封闭形式演化的网络对于这种切片是不变的。我们问还有什么因素使得输出（i）独立于同时事件的处理顺序，（ii）时间戳连续，即使两个事件在时间上交叉，同时（iii）对时间顺序保持敏感。对于任意非线性事件模型，我们证明（i）和（ii）各自等价于事件更新的成对交换，并且一旦更新交换，所有顺序依赖性都来自于它们与事件间动态的非交换，并在时间滞后中线性消失。这识别了一类时间介导的非交换 (TM) 模型，并产生任何模型的分辨率鲁棒性界限。我们构建了最小 TM 层，这是 Hassenstein-Reichardt 相关器的可学习、可证明的 Lipschitz 推广；证明没有一个附加层可以统一表示有序对相互作用，而三维 TM 状态可以；表明每个 TM 层添加了两层时间嵌套，而附加层则添加了一层；并给出单层高阶构造（TM-k）和保留所有三个属性的堆叠规则。我们将这些结果实例化为无时钟事件（CFE）层，与事件数量呈线性关系，为具有封闭形式可能性的时间点过程提供无拓扑变体，并为尖峰重定时攻击指定带有物理时间威胁模型的预注册时钟鲁棒性协议。在初步开发集实验中，TM 状态在 DVS128 手势上优于其他相同的加性状态 3.5-9.1 点，在 SHD 和语音命令上优于 24.5 和 30.6 点。
items.author: Han Wang, Jingyuan Bao, Juntao Wu, Saiao Zhou, Yuman Nie

items.title: Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries
items.titleZh: 从会员查询中学习彩票，最大限度地减少利益相关者的违规行为
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37828v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $\eta$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $\eta$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.

items.title: Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR
items.titleZh: 深度循环：迈向超高效的设备端 ASR
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37833v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.

摘要：现代自动语音识别（ASR）系统通过扩展模型深度和容量实现了显着的准确性，但代价是增加了内存、能源和计算需求。在通常最需要 ASR 的边缘设备（例如手表和眼镜）上，由于资源极其有限，部署如此大型的模型是不可行的。这就提出了一个基本问题：我们能否在不扩大参数化规模的情况下在深度 ASR 模型中实现高表征能力？在这项工作中，我们重新审视深度的作用并确定逐层表示动态，其中大多数层学习功能相似的转换。受这一见解的启发，我们提出了一种块循环 ASR 架构，该架构用一小组循环块取代参数化深度，每个循环块由权重共享层组成，从而保留有效深度，同时大幅减小模型大小。通过表示引导的分组和知识蒸馏，块循环模型保留了大型参考模型的准确性，同时使用数量级较少的参数。在 Open ASR Leaderboard 基准测试中，仅具有两个共享块的模型平均恢复了大型模型 97.4% 的准确率。紧凑的主干网络进一步通过轻量级 MoE-LoRA 适配实现高效的设备个性化，使用户特定的模型能够匹配或超越通用 ASR 系统的准确性，同时显着降低推理成本。通过在循环步骤中重用权重，所提出的架构减少了内存访问开销和推理能耗。总之，这些结果表明，无需大量参数化即可实现高质量的 ASR，并且结构化递归为边缘超压缩、节能和个性化语音识别提供了原则性路径。

items.title: Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling
items.titleZh: 通过超参数传输和集成改进数据受限的扩展
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37842v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.

arXiv:2610.37842v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随着计算预算的增长超过了高质量训练数据的增长，大型语言模型的训练必须同时考虑计算和数据约束。不幸的是，现有的数据受限扩展方案存在两个重要的限制。首先，过去的工作保留了关键的超参数，例如随规模固定的权重衰减，尽管最佳超参数随着模型大小和时期数的不同而有很大差异。其次，过去的工作忽略了集成，这是在数据限制下进行扩展的一个有前途的轴。令人惊讶的结果是，先前的处方可能会导致损失随着计算预算的增加而增加。我们通过拟合幂律来解决这两个限制，幂律规定如何使用尺度传输超参数，而缩放定律则规定如何通过集成分配计算。使用来自 FineWeb 的 100M 代币进行训练，与之前的方案相比，我们的方案将验证损失减少了 0.15 nat 以上，困惑度降低了 14%，并通过集成实现了计算的单调改进。这些收益是通过使用适合较小运行的处方来实现的，并在高达 12 美元\倍的计算预算下进行验证。

items.title: Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data
items.titleZh: 高维材料数据的可解释神经方程学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37880v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

arXiv:2610.37880v1 公告类型：新
摘要：方程学习旨在使用各种机器学习技术从数据中发现紧凑的、可解释的方程。然而，很少有工作流程能够在稀疏、高维材料数据集中发现并解释学习方程。我们提出了 nn-EQL，一种方程学习框架，它通过迭代训练、修剪和重新训练具有可定制的、用户指定的神经元级激活函数的神经网络来生成候选方程。使用最小描述长度 (MDL) 启发的分数对候选方程进行排名，平衡误差和稀疏性，并进行诊断以评估逐项贡献、输入缩放敏感性和不确定性。我们在标准 AI-Feynman 基准以及多尺度高维材料数据集（例如异质材料的有限元模拟和高通量实验薄膜沉积数据）上演示了 nn-EQL。 nn-EQL 通过标准编码器模型与表格数据和高维数据集成，学习方程并提供对学习术语的洞察。展望未来，整合物理可解释的表示、多模态和多保真度数据以及自适应数据采集可以使方程学习能够制定和测试机械假设。

items.title: SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning
items.titleZh: SAC-GCL：用于图对比学习的结构感知压缩
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37898v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.

摘要：图对比学习（GCL）通过最大化图的增强视图之间的一致性，在自监督表示学习中取得了显着的成功。尽管增强视图生成是 GCL 的核心步骤，但现有模型依赖于输入图的随机增强，例如边缘扰动和节点屏蔽，这些模型缺乏结构意识，经常破坏关键拓扑或引入语义不一致的视图。虽然最近的自适应方法改进了随机扰动，但它们主要在局部节点或边缘邻域上运行，无法捕获对图分类至关重要的高阶宏观结构组织。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了用于图对比学习的结构感知压缩（SAC-GCL），这是一种采用结构分解和图压缩作为原则视图生成策略的新颖框架。超越随机增强，SAC-GCL 利用结构分解技术来提取内聚子图并将其压缩为超级节点，构建粗化图视图，保留局部密度并捕获更高级别的结构模式，同时减少噪声和冗余。我们利用多个内聚子图模型来派生图的互补视图，每个视图都捕获不同的结构属性。为了捕获多分辨率信息，分层视图编码器通过使用共享权重内聚子图嵌入初始化超级节点特征来处理这些压缩视图。我们对六个基准数据集进行的广泛实验的结果表明，结构感知压缩为随机扰动提供了强大的替代方案，为图分类任务提供了更稳健和更具辨别力的图表示。

items.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
items.titleZh: 三思而行：Metis-1.6 技术报告
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.37903v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

arXiv:2610.37903v1 公告类型：新
摘要：Metis 押注于更好的数据、更好的训练方法和新的架构可以以很小的成本买到更多参数数量所买不到的东西。 Metis-1.6 是其最新的一步：由单个研究人员从头开始构建的两个语言模型，Praxis（2.94B 参数，每次传递 0.46B 活跃）和 Logos（10.23B 参数，每次传递 1.18B 活跃）。两者都针对每个令牌运行混合 Mamba-2 和注意力混合专家堆栈两次，因此每个令牌都会得到第二次查看。每个模型总共接受了 1.02T 个 token 的训练：804.76B 的预训练、18B 的上下文扩展至 131,072 个 token，以及 200B 的监督微调。 Metis-1.6 从来就不是为了挑战前沿模型，在 40 个训练后的基准测试中，它基本上也没有挑战：Logos 的平均值为 52.93，在其比较集中的 17 个模型中排名第七，与 Qwen3-4B 相差不远。但它达到了这一目标，大约是披露它的比较器中值训练数据的十二分之一，并且每个令牌的活动参数比任何击败它的模型都要少，这使它处于两者的帕累托前沿。在数学方面，它在 30 个模型中排名第二，在 AIME 2025 上占 67.50%，在 HMMT February 2026 上占 63.64%。它在代码、指令跟踪和长上下文方面较弱。报告的其余部分是我认为最有价值的部分：出了什么问题。我配置的优化器从未运行过，并且所有预训练都使用 AdamW 进行注意力训练。一个 1.77B 参数的 n-gram 存储器学会了自行关闭。五种微调选择的成本能力。一旦组的通过率超过 2/3，组均值归一化下的长度奖励就会惩罚较长的正确解决方案，这是我证明并用单行钳位修复的符号反转。我以 Metis-1.7 的循环架构 MoRE（递归专家混合）背后的 10B 代币消融作为结束语。
